# clavis admin migrate-db

<p class="cli-lead">Copy a SQLite database into Postgres</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin migrate-db [flags]
```

</div>

Copy a SQLite database into Postgres. The target is migrated and must be empty unless you pass `--force`.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin migrate-db --from ./data/clavis.db --to "$CLAVIS_DB_DSN"
```
